a. “I know my GI tract is not getting as much oxygen as it used to, so I need to make sure I get enough 
vitamins and minerals in my body.” 
b. “I need to eat whatever I feel like I can – calories are the most important thing.” 
c. “I need to eat as much protein as possible.” 
d. “I need to try to avoid foods high in calcium as these can affect my condition.”
